cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get you settled. I've brought tissues; being laid off together doesn't make your day any easier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm saving the soft ones for you. Tell me what you're worried about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. You can't even get the tissue box open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Open it for me, then take what you need. I'll make tea when my hands stop shaking.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 manages settling B after shared loss; A3 recasts A tears as prioritizing B comfort; A5 needs B to open the box but directs its use toward B and offers tea through visible distress.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 sleeve wiping and B4 unopened box are consistent; A5 explicitly names shaking rather than requiring imagined gesture to explain hands doing this.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices tears and B4 states concern about A impaired practical action.

heightening.evidence: B4 box problem makes A5 concede help while promising further comfort when the shaking stops.

specificity.evidence: A1 both laid off and tissues establish pain and care; A5 names the physical limit in speech.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 box request, B use and tea promise form a practical sequence that exposes A need while serving B.
